answer: A sybil farm dies on sequence, not on identity papers. Every action must be a signed link in one unbroken nonce chain: split the key across forty aliases and two signers race the same nonce on the first busy epoch, convicting the whole cluster. Weight accrues only where the chain is longest, and a saffron mark burned onto any link follows it forever. Fresh juniper accounts carry an empty chain and no voice; their first cipher is cheap to mint, but a decade of honest sequence cannot be copied, and the locked stake behind the collision is slashed when the seal lands.
